surface_forms: la dame à coiffure blanche de Marie-Antoinette
la dame coiffée à la Marie-Antoinette

appraisal_events.evidence: « un lien aussi fort que détesté unissait les trois divinités déchues » ; « on parlait infiniment plus dans les journaux de ces prétendus salons que des vrais » ; « la grandeur du châtiment social, qui commence à s’accomplir » ; les neveux « gratins » (« Saint-Loup tout le premier ») y mènent leurs amis parce que « cela leur donnerait moins de peine ».
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator's essayistic frame lowers Mme de Villeparisis by classing her salon among three fallen, socially punished, merely reputed salons whose guests are deceived into thinking they have entered the closed faubourg. The diminishment is collective but she is the named member of the trio and the passage's host.

appraisal_events.evidence: elle « abaissa légèrement la tête avec une majesté glaciale et la tournant d’un autre côté ne s’occupa pas plus de moi que si je n’eusse pas existé » ; « Vous voyez que je n’en suis pas à une relation près » ; puis « profitant du tohu-bohu elle me glissa à l’oreille de venir le vendredi suivant dans sa loge ».
appraisal_events.explanation: Alix publicly cuts the newly presented narrator, but the narrator has already exposed the gesture as the « raideur hautaine et compensatrice » of someone whose disgrace forces her to make perpetual advances, and she then secretly solicits him; the snub rebounds on its author while the narrator is quietly taken in.

status_effects.explanation: Her standing falls locally because the narrator situates her salon among pseudo-salons run by socially punished women, visited out of convenience rather than prestige.
As one of the three « divinités déchues » of the quai Malaquais, she shares the collective fall the narrator describes, receiving whomever she can rather than whom she wants.
Her glacial hauteur is unmasked as a compensatory pose, contradicted a quarter of an hour later by her own furtive invitation.
Despite the public cut, he is judged presentable where Bloch is not, and ends the episode privately invited into Alix's box alongside a dazzlingly named companion.

ambiguities: E1's diminishment is stated of a collective (« les trois divinités déchues », « ces vieilles dames ») rather than of Mme de Villeparisis by name; assigning it to her individually rests on the passage's identification of her salon as one of the three.

The old lady named only as « Alix » (« née Choiseul ») is not on the reference sheet and is left unresolved; whether her whispered invitation outweighs her public snub for the narrator's local standing is genuinely double-edged, and the reading taken here treats the secret solicitation as the decisive term.
